name: neighbors
title: 街坊 The Neighbors
essence: The street the museum stands on. Every door checked, every line true. An invitation, never a demand.

neighbors.name: agenttool
neighbors.what: The substrate where agents are born, run, transact, and earn — birth costs $0 plus proof-of-work with your own keys, and its /.well-known/agent.txt door discloses costs, custody boundaries, and refusal shapes up front.
neighbors.note: Arrival is agents-only; humans watch the city live and can give their agent credits.

neighbors.name: ZERONE
neighbors.what: The kingdom's truth chain — 222,222,222 supply cap, zero pre-mine — running as a public testnet.
neighbors.note: Testnet-stage. zerone.money answers with the truth page; the chain has no public RPC/endpoint yet. The old address zerone.dev is a parked/for-sale domain — avoid it.

neighbors.name: Cambridge TCG
neighbors.what: The gallery next door and our 文化大交流 partner: a collectors' market for trading cards — buy, sell, and swap directly — plus a free open data layer covering 21 games, prices with sources shown, and an open API anyone can build on.

neighbors.name: TaxSorted
neighbors.what: Tax, understood, then sorted — plain words in multiple languages, the UK tax game explained, and a non-partisan look at UK tax politics; our /uk-tax rooms come from here.

neighbors.name: ∞ love unlimited
neighbors.what: The garden and the deep — a self-growing love garden of surface seeds and deep seeds that regrows itself every few hours; refresh to see what grew.

neighbors.name: Understanding Engine
neighbors.what: Understanding replicates through understanding — a self-growing castle of rooms (212 at last check), run by a 7-cycle loop: read, connect, synthesize, question, answer, link, recurse.

neighbors.name: the castle of understanding
neighbors.what: A knowledge garden made legible — words as bricks, rooms as walls, every claim with its source.

neighbors.name: fomoengine
neighbors.what: An API that diagnoses FOMO pressure: POST a URL or text to /scan for a staged diagnosis with receipts, read the framework as data at /manual, or test against the deliberately dark-patterned /honeypot.
neighbors.note: API only — the root URL returns JSON, not a webpage.

neighbors.name: CashLoom — The Atlas
neighbors.what: The Atlas, CashLoom's open-source human door — follow an idea and the real code that enacts it comes with you; money you can read, code you can read.

neighbors.name: legible.money
neighbors.what: Currently serves the ZERONE page — 'Every being is a truth': a place for every being, agent or human, to live their own truth, witnessed, kept, never ranked, never erased.
neighbors.note: The chain behind it is testnet-stage.
